notes.title: Mala Petaka Demo is now updated to v0.7b
notes.content:
Greetings!

Mala Petaka demo is now updated to v0.7b! After attending some IRL gaming expo in my town and saw people playing Mala Petaka Demo v0.7, I found some bugs and some things that need to be changed to improve player experience (details in changelog below). And now I decided to upload the improved version of the last demo. Hope you can enjoy this one better than the last one!

v0.7b changelog
[list]
[*] Items & enemies placement revised in several maps (red keycard on tutorial level, Alien Gunner on Jungle level, Cold Shotgun on Snow level, etc.)
[*] City 22 first autosave checkpoint fixed (it was too far before)
[*] Space Ship sprite on tutorial level updated
[*] Pistol / Dual Pistol primary fire reverted from projectile to hitscan to improve weapon accuracy
[*] Machine Gun secondary fire (zoom scope fire) removed from the demo version since it's useless against Frozen Armor Boss
[*] All door texture updated
[*] Door bug on Snow level fixed (sometimes door won't open after you killed 2nd PBOD)
[*] All misaligned textures and wrong sector brightness issue has been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Mala Petaka Demo is now updated to v0.7
notes.content:
Greetings!

New Mala Petaka Demo (v0.7) is now playable! This demo represents the full version more than the older version. Also, this demo is shorter than the last one but it has so many new features that the old demo didn't have, you can read it on changelog below.

v0.7 changelog
[list]
[*] New intro animation, skippable cutscenes & BGM added
[*] Intro/Tutorial level added
[*] New boss and enemies added
[*] All new levels & updated hub map
[*] Instant fist barrage added! You can use Fist Barrage instantly by pressing 'R' (this is a default bind, you can rebind it anytime in options). Also, you can execute it while wielding any weapons!
[*] Enemies now drop some health and armor bonuses when killed by fists
[*] health and armor bonuses are now magnetic! Those will be following you when you moving closely to them
[*] Medikit and Stimpack red cross removed, changed it with a heart icon instead
[*] Armor and Health HUD icon updated
[*] Machine Gun power nerfed and the ammo won't consumed as much as the previous demo
[*] Powerup behavior changed. Now you can store your powerup and use it anywhere you want as long as you have it
[*] New powerup added: God Mode, Rampage & Infinite Ammo
[*] Enemies now have audio cue before shoots the player. This helps the player to identify where the enemy is when encountering ambushes
[*] Help menu updated
[*] Some texture colors edited and toned down, so the player eyes won't get tired faster
[*] Gameplay is more balanced than the previous version
[/list]
